name: Mount Kisco Commons
summary: Mount Kisco Commons is a community shopping center in the heart of Mount Kisco, New York, featuring major anchors Target and Stop & Shop alongside popular dining options like Chipotle and Dunkin'. This convenient one-stop destination serves the northern Westchester County area with a practical mix of retail, grocery, and service tenants.
demographics: Mount Kisco Commons serves a diverse suburban demographic in northern Westchester County, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The primary trade area includes Mount Kisco and surrounding communities like Bedford, Chappaqua, and Katonah, drawing professionals, families with children, and affluent retirees. Shoppers typically visit for convenient one-stop shopping combining grocery needs at Stop & Shop with everyday essentials from Target, along with quick-service dining options. The center appeals to time-conscious consumers seeking efficiency and value in a suburban setting.
description: Mount Kisco Commons is a community shopping center strategically located at 195 North Bedford Road in the heart of Mount Kisco, New York, serving as an essential retail hub for northern Westchester County. This open-air shopping destination combines national retailers with local businesses to create a convenient one-stop shopping experience for the surrounding communities. Anchored by major retailers including Target and Stop & Shop supermarket, the center offers a comprehensive mix of shopping, dining, and service options that cater to everyday needs. Dining options include popular quick-service restaurants like Chipotle and Dunkin', while specialty retailers such as Outlet Wines & Liquors provide additional shopping variety. The center also features professional services including Tribeca Pediatrics, making it a true community gathering place. Managed by Urban Edge Properties, Mount Kisco Commons maintains a strong reputation with a 4.4-star rating from over 544 reviews, reflecting its importance to local residents who appreciate the convenience and accessibility of having essential retailers and services in one location.
